items.q: How fast do I get a reply?
items.a: We reply as fast as we can, usually the same day on working days. Calling or WhatsApp is quickest.

items.q: Do I get a quote right away?
items.a: Our prices are simply [on the site](Diensten). Online Growth costs €150 a month and AI Consulting €200 a month (introductory price), both excl. VAT and cancellable monthly. In a free 30-minute demo we look at what your business needs. For [EML AI Team](https://NIEUW-EML-AI-TEAM-DOMEIN/) we always start with a free analysis.

items.q: Can we meet in person somewhere?
items.a: We work fully online. We do the free demo via Teams: 30 minutes, without you having to travel. After that, we handle everything remotely.

items.q: Do you work with startups too?
items.a: Yes. Online Growth (€150 a month, excl. VAT) is there for every business that wants to be found online and follow up its customers, even if you're just starting out. Want to learn to work with AI yourself? Then there's AI Consulting. For larger businesses with a team, there's EML AI Team.
